prompt: For all numbers a and b, the operation ★ is defined by a ★ b = ab - a - b. If (3 ★ n) ★ 2 = 13, what is the value of n ★ n?
What is the value of the product (1 - 1/2^2)(1 - 1/3^2)(1 - 1/4^2) x ... x (1 - 1/10^2), which has one factor for each whole number from 2 through 10?
In the four-digit number 7A4B, A and B stand for digits (they may be equal). How many different choices of the digits A and B make 7A4B divisible by 36?
Two positive integers have a greatest common factor of 12, and their product is 15,552. What is the least possible value of the sum of the two integers?
What is the value of (8 x 10^-3)^2 / (4 x 10^-8)?
For a positive integer n, let D(n) be the number of positive divisors of n. For example, D(6) = 4 because 6 has divisors 1, 2, 3 and 6. What is the value of D(D(48) x D(20))?

Rosa thinks of a number. She multiplies it by 3, subtracts 8 from the result, divides that result by 2, and finally adds 5. Her final answer is 19. What number did Rosa have just after she subtracted 8?
What is the sum of all the two-digit whole numbers whose two digits add up to 9?
What is the remainder when 5^100 + 9^100 is divided by 7?
What is the sum of all positive integers n for which (3n + 20)/(n + 2) is an integer?
How many three-digit whole numbers have digits whose product is 24 and are also divisible by 9?
What is the greatest common factor of 2^20 - 1 and 2^12 - 1?
How many prime numbers are between 30 and 60?
How many positive integers less than 100 have exactly three positive divisors?

A three-digit number is chosen so that the number formed by writing its digits in reverse order is also a three-digit number. When the reversed number is subtracted from the original number, the result is 396. How many three-digit numbers have this property?
Three eighths of a number is 27. What is five sixths of the same number?
How many zeros are at the end of the number 25^6 x 12^5 when it is written out in full?
What is the value of 0.2 x 0.3 + 0.4 / 0.05?
How many of the integers 1, 2, 3, ..., 50 can be written in the form a^2 - b^2, where a and b are whole numbers (0 is allowed)?

A jar holds only nickels (5 cents each), dimes (10 cents each), and quarters (25 cents each). The numbers of nickels, dimes, and quarters are in the ratio 4 : 1 : 1, and the coins in the jar are worth $52.80 in all. How many dimes are in the jar?

Working together, Ana and Ben can paint a fence in 6 hours. On another day they paint an identical fence a different way: Ana works alone for 4 hours, and then Ben works alone for 9 hours, which finishes the fence. Each of them works at the same steady rate on both days. How many hours would Ben take to paint the fence working alone?

At a market, one pound of tea costs 4 times as much as one pound of coffee. After a poor harvest, the price of tea rises 40 percent while the price of coffee falls 30 percent. Mr. Okafor always buys 3 pounds of tea and 2 pounds of coffee. By what percent does the cost of his usual purchase increase?

A bus makes one trip between two towns, including a single 10-minute stop. Whenever it is moving, it travels at 45 kilometers per hour. Its average speed for the whole trip, counting the stop, is 36 kilometers per hour. How many kilometers apart are the towns?

Gear A, which has 24 teeth, meshes with gear B, which has 15 teeth. Gear B is fixed to the same axle as gear C, so B and C always turn together. Gear C, which has 42 teeth, meshes with gear D, which has 12 teeth. When gear A makes 10 complete turns, how many turns does gear D make?
Ana, Ben, and Cal share $560. Two-thirds of Ana's share, three-fifths of Ben's share, and three-eighths of Cal's share are all the same amount. How many dollars does Ben receive?

Region A has 12,000 residents living on 40 square kilometers. Region B has an area of 30 square kilometers, and its population density (residents per square kilometer) is 25 percent greater than Region A's. How many residents does Region B have?

A store sells the same shampoo in four offers.
Offer A: a 250-milliliter bottle for $3.90
Offer B: a 750-milliliter bottle for $10.50
Offer C: a 500-milliliter bottle priced at $8.00, with 20 percent off
Offer D: 300-milliliter bottles at $4.80 each, buy two and get a third bottle free
With each offer's deal applied, which offer gives the lowest price per 100 milliliters?

One batch of a cookie recipe uses 5 cups of flour, 3 eggs, and 2/3 cup of butter. A baker has 52 cups of flour, 38 eggs, and 4 1/2 cups of butter, and she makes as many whole batches as her supplies allow. How many eggs does she have left over?

Money is deposited in an account that pays 20 percent interest per year, compounded annually. Nothing else is added or withdrawn. The interest credited at the end of the third year is $720. How many dollars were deposited?

A rectangular room is 10 meters long and 5 meters wide, and its walls are 2.5 meters high. All four walls (but not the ceiling) get two coats of paint; ignore doors and windows. One liter of paint covers 8 square meters for one coat, and paint is sold only in 1-liter cans that cost $15 each. What is the least amount the paint can cost?

A rower can row at 20 kilometers per hour in still water. On a river, rowing a certain distance upstream takes her 4 times as long as rowing the same distance downstream. What is the speed of the current, in kilometers per hour?
Ana, Ben, and Cal share $600. Ana receives one-third as much as Ben and Cal receive together, and Ben receives one-fourth as much as Ana and Cal receive together. How many dollars does Cal receive?

A shop sells a toy for $10. Each toy costs the shop $6, and the shop sells 100 of the toys each week. After an advertising campaign, the shop raises the price by 10 percent, its cost per toy rises by 25 percent, and its weekly sales rise by 40 percent. By what percent does the shop's weekly profit increase?

A 150-meter train traveling at 90 kilometers per hour overtakes a 210-meter train traveling at 54 kilometers per hour on a parallel track in the same direction. How many seconds pass from the moment the front of the faster train reaches the back of the slower train until the back of the faster train passes the front of the slower train?

An airport has a moving walkway. When Leo walks along the moving walkway at his usual pace, he gets from one end to the other in 30 seconds. When he stands still on it, the trip takes 50 seconds. How many seconds would Leo take to walk the same distance on the floor beside the walkway at his usual pace?

Mix P is sand and cement in the ratio 3 : 1 by mass, and Mix Q is sand and cement in the ratio 5 : 3 by mass. A builder combines 20 kilograms of Mix P with 16 kilograms of Mix Q. How many kilograms of pure cement must she add so that the ratio of sand to cement in the whole batch becomes 2 : 1?

Ana deposits $2,500 in an account that pays 6 percent simple annual interest. Ben deposits $2,000 in a different account that pays simple annual interest. At what annual interest rate, in percent, must Ben's account pay so that the two balances are equal after 5 years?

A cyclist leaves town A and a second cyclist leaves town B at the same moment, and they ride toward each other along the same road at steady speeds. After they pass each other, the cyclist from A needs 9 more hours to reach town B, and the cyclist from B needs 1 more hour to reach town A. The cyclist from A rides at 10 kilometers per hour. How many kilometers apart are the towns?
The function f is defined by f(x) = ax + b, where a and b are constants and a > 0. For every number x, f(f(x)) = 16x + 15. What is the value of f(2)?
The nonzero numbers x and y satisfy 1/x + 1/y = 5/6 and 1/x - 1/y = 1/6. What is the value of x + y?
The function f is defined by f(x) = x^2 + bx + c, where b and c are constants. If f(1) = 5 and f(3) = 15, what is the value of f(5)?
The functions f and g satisfy f(x) = 2x - 1 and g(f(x)) = 6x + 5 for every number x. What is the value of g(7)?
What is the value of 8^(-2/3) x 4^(3/2) ?
For integers a and b, (sqrt(6) + sqrt(2))^2 = a + b sqrt(3). What is the value of a + b?
How many integers x satisfy |x - 2| + |x + 4| <= 10?
The numbers x and y satisfy x + y = 6 and x^2 + y^2 = 30. What is the value of x^3 + y^3?
The numbers a and b are positive, and a^2 - 4ab + 4b^2 = 0. What is the value of (a + 3b)/(a + b)?
The system of equations 4x + ay = 18 and 6x + 9y = b, where a and b are constants, has infinitely many solutions (x, y). What is the value of a + b?
The numbers x and y satisfy 2 <= x <= 5 and 3 <= y <= 8. What is the greatest possible value of (x + y)/x ?
What is the sum of all the positive numbers x that satisfy x^4 - 13x^2 + 36 = 0 ?
The function g is defined by g(x) = k|x - 4| + 3, where k is a constant. If g(1) = 15, what is the value of g(10)?
The function f is defined by f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 5. The equation f(x) = k, where k is a constant, has exactly one solution. What is the value of f(k)?
The expression 2x^2 + 8x + 3 can be written in the form 2(x + h)^2 + k, where h and k are constants. What is the value of h + k?
A ball is thrown upward. Its height, in feet, t seconds after it is thrown is h(t) = -16t^2 + 80t + 6. For how many seconds is the ball more than 70 feet above the ground?
How many integers x satisfy both x^2 < 50 and x^3 > -30 ?
The function f is defined by f(x) = x^2 + 4x + c, where c is a constant. The least value of f(x) is 7. What is the value of f(1)?
The supplement of an angle is 4 times as large as the complement of the same angle. What is the measure of the angle, in degrees?
A right triangle has legs of length 15 centimeters and 20 centimeters. What is the length, in centimeters, of the altitude drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse?

Two solid statues have exactly the same shape, one an enlarged copy of the other. The smaller statue has a total surface area of 48 square inches and the larger has a total surface area of 108 square inches. The smaller statue has a volume of 64 cubic inches. What is the volume of the larger statue, in cubic inches?

A closed cylindrical can has a volume of 196(pi) cubic centimeters, and the area of its curved side (not counting the top and bottom) is 56(pi) square centimeters. What is the height of the can, in centimeters?
A regular hexagon and an equilateral triangle have the same perimeter. The area of the triangle is 36 square inches. What is the area of the hexagon, in square inches?
When the radius of a circle is increased by 2 centimeters, the area of the circle increases by 40(pi) square centimeters. What is the circumference of the ORIGINAL circle, in centimeters?
A square has a perimeter of 48 meters. A rectangular garden has the same area as the square, and the garden is 18 meters long. What is the perimeter of the garden, in meters?

An open box is made from a rectangular sheet of cardboard 20 inches long and 12 inches wide by cutting a 2-inch by 2-inch square from each corner and folding up the four flaps. What is the volume of the box, in cubic inches?
In triangle ABC, angle A measures 50 degrees and angle B measures 70 degrees. The bisector of angle C meets side AB at point D. What is the measure of angle ADC, in degrees?
At each vertex of a triangle, one exterior angle is drawn. The three exterior angles are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. What is the measure of the largest INTERIOR angle of the triangle, in degrees?

In a right triangle, the altitude drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse divides the hypotenuse into two pieces of length 4 centimeters and 9 centimeters. What is the area of the triangle, in square centimeters?

A square, a regular hexagon, and a third regular polygon are placed so that each has one vertex at the same point and together they fill the space around that point exactly, with no gaps or overlaps. How many sides does the third polygon have?

A square is drawn inside a semicircle of radius 5 inches so that one side of the square lies along the diameter of the semicircle and the other two vertices of the square lie on the curved arc. What is the area of the square, in square inches?

The area of a larger circle is 4 times the area of a smaller circle. The sum of the circumferences of the two circles is 30(pi) centimeters. What is the area of the SMALLER circle, in square centimeters?

Triangle PQR is drawn with all three vertices on a circle, and side PQ is a diameter of the circle. PQ is 26 centimeters long and PR is 10 centimeters long. What is the area of triangle PQR, in square centimeters?

A street lamp is at the top of a 6-meter vertical post. A person 1.5 meters tall stands on level ground 6 meters from the base of the post. The light from the lamp casts the person's shadow straight away from the post. How long, in meters, is the person's shadow?
ABCD is a square. Equilateral triangle ABE is drawn outside the square, sharing side AB with it. Segment DE is drawn. What is the measure of angle AED, in degrees?

A sector with a central angle of 216 degrees is cut from a circular sheet of paper with radius 5 inches. The two straight edges of the sector are joined, with no overlap, to form the curved surface of a cone. What is the volume of the cone, in cubic inches? (The volume of a cone is (1/3) x pi x r^2 x h.)

In trapezoid ABCD, side AB is parallel to side CD, AB = 6 centimeters, and CD = 12 centimeters. The diagonals AC and BD cross at point P. Triangle APB has an area of 8 square centimeters. What is the area of the whole trapezoid, in square centimeters?

In the coordinate plane, point P(-2, 4) is reflected across the vertical line x = 3 to give point Q. Then Q is reflected across the horizontal line y = 1 to give point R. What is the distance from P to R?
A clock with hour and minute hands and no numbers on its face is seen in a mirror hanging on the opposite wall. In the mirror, the clock appears to show 4:35. What is the actual time?
How many points (x, y) in the coordinate plane, where x and y are both integers, satisfy |x| + |y| <= 4?
What is the units digit of the sum 2^1 + 2^2 + 2^3 + ... + 2^50?
A sequence begins 3, 4, and each term after the second is the sum of the two terms just before it: 3, 4, 7, 11, 18, 29, .... How many of the first 20 terms are even?

A conveyor belt moves at a constant 0.6 meter per second. Boxes are placed on the belt so that the front of each box is 1.5 meters behind the front of the box ahead of it. How many boxes pass the end of the belt in 1 hour?
Ferries leave a dock every 18 minutes all day, and the first ferry of the day leaves at 6:05 a.m. Rosa arrives at the dock at 10:14 a.m. How many minutes must she wait for the next ferry to leave?
A point (a, b) is reflected across the line y = x, and the image is then translated 3 units to the left and 2 units down. The final point is (4, -1). What is the value of a?
A snail crawls at a steady 1.2 centimeters per second. At this rate, how many hours does it take the snail to crawl 0.54 kilometer?

In the coordinate plane, A is the point (1, 3) and B is the point (9, 5). A path runs in a straight line from A to a point P on the x-axis, and then in a straight line from P to B. What is the least possible length of this path?

A cube-shaped tank measures 1.2 meters along each inside edge and is completely full of water. A drain removes water at a steady 4 liters per minute. How many hours does it take to empty the tank? (1 cubic meter = 1000 liters)

At noon, two clocks with ordinary 12-hour dials are both set to the correct time. One clock gains 2 minutes every hour and the other loses 3 minutes every hour. After how many days will the two clocks next show exactly the same time?

In the coordinate plane, a rectangle has sides parallel to the axes, and two of its opposite corners are (1, 1) and (7, 9). A line through the origin divides the rectangle into two regions of equal area. What is the slope of the line?

Figure n of a pattern is an n-by-n square made of n^2 small square tiles. Every tile that touches the outer edge of the figure is gray, and every other tile is white. In Figure 20, how many more white tiles are there than gray tiles?

Two candles are the same height. Burning at a steady rate, the first candle burns down completely in 4 hours and the second in 6 hours. Both candles are lit at the same moment. At the moment when the second candle is exactly twice as tall as the first, what fraction of its original height does the second candle have left?

A clock strikes once at 1 o'clock, twice at 2 o'clock, and so on, up to 12 times at 12 o'clock, both day and night. It also strikes once at every half hour (1:30, 2:30, and so on). How many times does it strike from 9:45 a.m. on Monday to 1:45 a.m. on Wednesday?
In an arithmetic sequence, the sum of the first 10 terms is 155 and the sum of the first 20 terms is 610. What is the 30th term of the sequence?

The point P(2, 5) is reflected across the line y = x. The image is then reflected across the x-axis, that image is reflected across the line y = x, that image across the x-axis, and so on, alternating between the two lines, for 100 reflections in all. What are the coordinates of the final point?
A row has 8 seats. Three of the seats are to be chosen for three children so that no two of the chosen seats are next to each other. How many different sets of 3 seats can be chosen?
A lock uses a 4-digit code. Each digit can be any of 0 through 9, and digits may repeat. How many of the possible codes have at least one digit that appears more than once?

Two fair six-sided number cubes, each numbered 1 through 6, are rolled. What is the probability that the larger of the two numbers showing is exactly 4? (If both cubes show the same number, that number counts as the larger.)
On a trip, each of 50 hikers was asked what they packed. 42 packed water, 40 packed a map, and 37 packed a snack. What is the least possible number of hikers who packed all three?
The mean of 12 numbers is 30. Each of the 5 largest numbers is decreased by 6, and each of the other 7 numbers is increased by 3. What is the mean of the 12 new numbers?
A florist places 12 identical roses into 4 different vases so that every vase gets at least 2 roses. All 12 roses are used. In how many different ways can this be done?
A committee of 3 students is to be chosen from a group of 8 students. Two of the 8, Rina and Theo, refuse to serve on the same committee. How many different committees are possible?
One of the positive whole-number divisors of 180 is chosen at random, each divisor equally likely. What is the probability that the divisor chosen is a perfect square?

The table shows how many pets each of 20 students owns, but two counts are missing.
Pets owned | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
Number of students | 2 | a | 3 | b | 1
The mean number of pets owned by the 20 students is 2.1. What is the value of b?

Ana picks one card at random from five cards numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. Ben picks one card at random from four cards numbered 2, 4, 6 and 8. What is the probability that Ana's number is greater than Ben's number?

A rectangle is divided by straight lines into a grid of equal squares with 3 rows and 4 columns. Including the whole rectangle and the single squares, how many rectangles of any size are formed by the lines of the grid?
A whole number from 1 to 100, inclusive, is chosen at random. What is the probability that the number chosen has an odd number of positive divisors?

Eight students are to be split into 4 pairs of lab partners. The pairs are not labeled or ordered; only who is paired with whom matters. In how many different ways can the 8 students be split into pairs?

A fair six-sided number cube is rolled. If it shows 1 or 2, a marble is drawn at random from Bag A, which holds 2 red marbles and 2 white marbles. Otherwise, a marble is drawn at random from Bag B, which holds 1 red marble and 4 white marbles. What is the probability that the marble drawn is red?
Two fair six-sided number cubes, each numbered 1 through 6, are rolled. What is the probability that the two numbers showing differ by 2 or more?
Ten cards are numbered 1 through 10. Two of the cards are drawn at random at the same time. What is the probability that the product of the two numbers drawn is even?
Three fair coins are tossed. You are told only that at least one of the coins landed heads. Given this, what is the probability that all three coins landed heads?

Maya climbs a staircase of 6 stairs. With each step she goes up either 1 stair or 2 stairs. The order of her steps matters, so going up 1 then 2 is different from going up 2 then 1. In how many different ways can she climb the 6 stairs?
